subject: a friendly compact paper dragon holding a sun disc in its body
pose: curling around the disc with one small wing raised
requested_medium: paper engineering and flat sun-disc sculpture
art_direction: 一只短身纸龙由无字票纸折成，橙色圆日嵌入腹部，青蓝纸鳍与卷尾形成大胆收束轮廓。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Engineer a friendly short-bodied dragon from blank folded ticket paper, with no printed words, numbers, or barcodes. Its body curls around a flat orange sun disc held within the belly opening, while one small blue paper wing lifts beside the head. Keep the head blunt, the eyes small and welcoming, and the tail curled inward; use no teeth or dramatic claws. Show the paper folds, perforation-like edge rhythm, and a few cyan reverse faces. The sun remains a solid matte disc rather than a glowing effect. Set the sculpture against deep desaturated blue, centered at three-quarter view. Keep the complete dragon and disc inside the circular avatar crop, with no scenery or extra decorations.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
